answer: Give every new identity a reputation nadir of zero and admit it only through a small oasis of established sponsors: each sponsor locks refundable collateral on the newcomer, slashed if the newcomer spams or double-votes. Beyond that oasis lies a tundra of unverified accounts that cannot vote, earn, or take work until they complete counterparty-confirmed jobs. Forging a thousand identities then means finding a thousand sponsors willing to risk real collateral, so the attack costs more than any vote it could buy.
